units.source_text: 后来对右近说：“我想派人到水里去寻找，

en.t: Later she said to Ukon, “I want to send someone to search in the water,

units.source_text: 至少总要把遗骸好好地找回来，才好殡葬。”

en.t: at the very least, we must find the remains and bring them back properly, so that we can hold the funeral.”

units.source_text: 右近答道：“此刻到水里去寻找，还有什么用处呢？

en.t: Ukon answered, “What use would it be to search in the water now?

units.source_text: 遗骸早已流到去向不明的大海中去了。

en.t: The remains must have long since drifted away into the vast sea, with no telling where they have gone.

units.source_text: 况且做此无益之事，叫世人纷纷传说，

en.t: Besides, if we do such a useless thing and set everyone talking,

units.source_text: 母夫人左思右想，悲情充塞胸中，实在无法排遣。

en.t: The mother thought it over from every side, but grief filled her breast and she truly had no way to ease it.

units.source_text: 于是右近与侍从二人推一辆车子到浮舟房间门口，

en.t: So Ukon and the maid Jiju pushed a cart to Ukifune’s doorway,

units.source_text: 把她平日所铺的褥垫、身边常用的器具，以及她身上脱下来的衣服等等，尽行装入车中，

en.t: and loaded into it all the bedding she usually lay on, the utensils she kept close at hand, the clothes she had taken off, and everything else of that kind,

units.source_text: 叫乳母家做和尚的儿子及其叔父阿阇梨、平素熟悉的阿阇梨弟子、一向相识的老法师，

en.t: summoning the nurse’s son, who had become a monk, his uncle the ajari, the ajari’s disciples who were usually close to them, and an old priest they had long known,

units.source_text: 以及七七四十九日中应邀来做功德的僧人，装作搬运亡人遗骸的样子，一同把车子拉出去。

en.t: as well as the monks invited to perform memorial rites during the forty-nine days, and had them all pull the cart away as if they were carrying the dead woman’s remains.

units.source_text: 乳母和母夫人不堪悲痛，躺在地上号哭。

en.t: The nurse and the mother, unable to bear their grief, lay on the floor and wailed aloud.

units.source_text: 此时那个内舍人——就是以前为了值夜之事来警戒右近的那个老人——

en.t: At that time, that palace guard, the old man who had previously come to warn Ukon about the night watch,

units.source_text: 带了他的女婿右近大夫也来了。

en.t: also came, bringing his son-in-law, Ukon no Taifu.

units.source_text: 他说：“殡葬之事，应该禀明大将，择定日期，郑重举行才好。”

en.t: He said, “For the funeral, you should inform the Captain, choose a date, and hold it with proper ceremony.”

units.source_text: 右近答道：“只因有个缘故，务求勿使人知，

en.t: Ukon answered, “Because there is a certain reason, we very much want to keep this from becoming known,

units.source_text: 所以特地在今夜以前办了。

en.t: and so we deliberately completed it before tonight.
